kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Zelenskyy tells NPR Ukraine wants peace but will hit Russia until it follows ceasefire
wire.summary: In an interview with NPR, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he was informed the U.S. warned it could cut off access to U.S. weapons and intelligence, but that it hasn't happened yet.

wire.title: Writer Yiyun Li lost both of her sons. When words fell short, she turned to music
wire.summary: Li won a Pulitzer for her memoir about the suicides of her two sons. In her new novel, Music Against the Night , she writes about two young prodigies in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.

wire.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
wire.summary: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

wire.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
wire.summary: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.

wire.title: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
wire.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

wire.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
wire.summary: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

wire.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
wire.summary: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.

wire.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
wire.summary: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

wire.title: Some of the most pristine coral reefs have a secret weapon: birds
wire.summary: Coral reefs are facing increasing threats around the globe. But on a remote Pacific island, scientists have found that reefs can get help from a surprising ally: seabirds.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Trump will headline a rally in Alaska Tuesday, federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home Monday, Trump's diesel deal with Russia frustrates European leaders.

wire.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
wire.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

wire.title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
wire.summary: The sentence marks an end to the mystery around Tupac's cold case, which has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.

wire.title: Saudi coalition strikes fuel depot near Yemen's capital
wire.summary: The Houthis have warned Saudi Arabia that they will retaliate by targeting the Saudi cities of Riyadh and Dammam.

wire.title: Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
wire.summary: Police say preliminary information suggests the man who died at the Georgia amusement park fell from a ride.

wire.title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
wire.summary: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.

wire.title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
wire.summary: Guilfoyle the allegations of improper conduct are "false" and being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".
